messages.content: Scrivi in italiano una guida tecnica dettagliata di circa 1500 parole su come Android gestisce la memoria virtuale. Spiega tabelle delle pagine, fault, file mappati, memoria anonima, zRAM e pressione di memoria. Usa esempi concreti e termina con un confronto ragionato tra le diverse strategie.

Write a detailed tutorial of about 1500 words explaining how to design a reliable offline file importer on Android. Cover streaming input, validation, bounded memory, cancellation, atomic publication, resumable work and failure recovery, with concrete examples and tradeoffs.

Design and explain a C++20 bounded producer-consumer queue for an offline inference engine. Include complete code, ownership rules, cancellation, shutdown, worker failures and a worked execution trace. Discuss deadlocks and memory ordering in detail. Aim for a substantial tutorial with at least eight concrete failure scenarios.

Analyze a hypothetical warehouse with three machines and two workers. Each order needs 4 minutes on machine A, 7 on B and 3 on C, in that order. Workers attend only the first and last minute of each operation; machines run unattended otherwise. Design a feasible schedule for six orders, show start and finish times, verify resource conflicts, derive lower bounds and explain whether your schedule is optimal. State assumptions and examine two alternative schedules.
